name: US Bureau of Labor Statistics
summary: US labor and price statistics (CPI, PPI, employment, unemployment, wages) as time series from the BLS Public Data API v2.

registration_key.description: a free BLS Public Data API v2 registration key (register on bls.gov/developers; the key arrives by email). Sent as the registrationkey query parameter.

notes: v2 limits per key: 500 queries a day, 50 series and 20 years per query, 50 requests per 10 seconds.
Series ids are uppercase codes and may contain _, - and #; lowercase letters and other characters are rejected. The popular-series and survey endpoints help find them.
With no years given, a series call returns the past three years. Years are four-digit YYYY values.
The optional catalog, calculations, annualaverage and aspects outputs need the registration key.

endpoints.name: Get one series
endpoints.summary: Data for one series id, the past three years, or only the latest observation.

latest.description: true returns only the most recent observation.

endpoints.name: Get several series over a year range
endpoints.summary: Data for up to 50 series between two years, with optional catalog metadata, net/percent changes and annual averages.

endyear.description: Last year, YYYY; at most 20 years after startyear.

catalog.description: Include series catalog metadata (title, survey, area...). Default false.

calculations.description: Include net and percent changes. Default false.

aspects.description: Include aspect data (e.g. standard errors) where the series has it. Default false.

notes: A read sent as a POST with a JSON body.

endpoints.name: List popular series
endpoints.summary: The 25 most requested series ids, overall or within one survey.

endpoints.name: List surveys
endpoints.summary: Every BLS survey with its abbreviation (CU, LN, CE, ...).

endpoints.name: Get a survey
endpoints.summary: Metadata for one survey by abbreviation.
